messages:
Anya (Product Design): sharing a quick mock — trying a 'pin lane' on the left to separate pinned versions from filter controls. link: https://www.figma.com/file/pin-lane

Sam (PM): neat. what's the main user problem?

Anya (Product Design): advanced users keep multiple pinned versions; current UI mixes pins with filters so it's hard to scan. goal: persistent compare context across navigation and clearer pin labeling.

Rachel (Design): +1. suggestion: show a thin collapsed rail state with counts only so toggling doesn't jolt the table.

Leo (Frontend): overlay for collapsed rail avoids reflow but watch z-index and focus. doable.

Alex (A11y): ensure toggle has aria-expanded and announce pin changes via aria-live. also need keyboard targets >=44px.

Julie (Data): quick metric: ~12% of compare sessions touch pin; retention low. I can add pin.create/pin.remove events to track persistence impact.

Kai (Eng): estimate ~8 dev days + 2 qa days to implement collapsed rail + pin lane + icon-only badges. server persist is separate.

Anya (Product Design): copy tweak: use sentence case "Pin to compare" and tooltip "Keep this version in your compare lane". will update figma.

Rachel (Design): microcopy acked. also add tap-to-open for badges on mobile.

Leo (Frontend): will lazy-load metric details when badge flyout opens to save payload.

ci-bot: staging deployment scheduled 2026-04-01T06:00Z for UI experiment. :rocket:

Sam (PM): great thread. Anya, drop the updated figma link when ready and I'll add to sprint.
